Db2 for z/OS 13: concurrency controls and locking

records.original_contract: Channel subsystem can execute device I/O asynchronously to central processor; channels and control units form a topology, not language async.
records.semantic_gap: Async C# tasks, gRPC or AKS cannot reproduce CSS/SAP/FICON topology by naming alone.
records.negative_control: Throttle or break one storage/log path while throughput appears healthy.
records.independent_oracle: End-to-end request-to-durable-commit traces plus path failover and log flush p99.
required_measurements: device queue depth and service time

records.original_contract: WLM classification targets goals and importance with service classes and performance periods; resource pressure changes dispatch behavior.
records.semantic_gap: Kubernetes PriorityClass, HPA and CPU quotas have different scheduling/queueing semantics and may not guarantee class p99.
records.negative_control: CPU saturation allows low-priority work to starve critical online commits.
records.independent_oracle: Correlated per-class p95/p99 and queue-delay oracle under controlled contention.

records.original_contract: Db2 isolation UR/CS/RS/RR changes visibility and locking; application bind options can influence semantics.
records.semantic_gap: SQL isolation names and driver defaults do not prove equal query, phantom, lock and time-out behavior across Db2 and PostgreSQL.
records.negative_control: Concurrent transfer and balance query sees forbidden uncommitted or inconsistent financial result.
records.independent_oracle: Concurrent schedule matrix, rollback/deadlock/phantom observations and booked balance invariant.

records.original_contract: Commitment control groups journaled changes into a unit of work with COMMIT/ROLLBACK; job/activation group recovery context matters.
records.semantic_gap: IBM i job/journal/commit boundaries are not IBM Z Db2 or an automatically portable Kafka transaction.
records.negative_control: Aborted job leaves partial posted balances in candidate or corrupt cursor.
records.independent_oracle: Source/target reconciliation across aborted jobs, journal position and restart.

records.original_contract: An Access defines the physical ordering and retrieval of dataset records; it is not simply a SQL table or view.
records.semantic_gap: Replacing an MCP Access with a SQL index without record ordering/selection proof may silently reorder financial batch or query results.
records.negative_control: Equivalent rows return in different order or duplicates after a restart.
records.independent_oracle: Ordered-key and selection oracle over authorized source and candidate data, including duplicates.

records.original_contract: MCP Transaction Server has configured synchronized recovery capabilities; database rollback and security are documented in training scope.
records.semantic_gap: HTTP request/response and a queue do not automatically reproduce coordinated recovery scope.
records.negative_control: Lose reply after commit and retry; reject duplicate confirmed effects.
records.independent_oracle: Authorized source UOW trace, single financial decision and idempotent recovery.

records.original_contract: TIP connector can reconnect and resend on send error; vendor cautions that this may be inappropriate for stateful applications.
records.semantic_gap: Blind REST/gRPC retry or reconnect does not preserve TIP session state or the actual host commit outcome.
records.negative_control: Host committed, acknowledgement lost; reconnect resends and attempts double debit.
records.independent_oracle: Correlate one source commit, one target decision, client UNKNOWN and later query for outcome.

records.original_contract: ePortal TIP modernization documentation requires MCB for the supported path and excludes COMPOOL in that path.
records.semantic_gap: Adapter compatibility for a documented TIP path does not establish universal support of custom terminal or COMPOOL behavior.
records.negative_control: Unsupported message form is silently accepted with fields omitted.
records.independent_oracle: Original TIP message/control-ID round-trip and explicit unsupported-case refusal.

records.original_contract: Fujitsu announced GS21 models and GSS21sx V20 in 2018; installed OS/runtime, data store and I/O path are not established by that announcement.
records.semantic_gap: An archived model announcement does not prove MSP/XSP feature set, current vendor support or equivalent IBM z/OS semantics.
records.negative_control: Architect assigns CICS/Db2 or a generic CDC tool based only on the GS21 brand.
records.independent_oracle: Fail closed without operator inventory of model/OS, actual DB, JCL and recovery behavior.

records.original_contract: Specific installed NEC ACOS system, database and release not provided; do not assume capability presence or absence.
records.semantic_gap: No vendor contract is verified for the installation.
records.negative_control: A proposed mapping asserts native log CDC or SQL equivalence with no product/version source.
records.independent_oracle: Independent vendor manual + authorized operator confirmation are prerequisites; no PASS possible here.

records.original_contract: Exact GCOS model and subsystem/version unknown; pending primary manual and customer configuration.
records.semantic_gap: GCOS products and configurations cannot be treated as a homogeneous technology.
records.negative_control: Generic pattern implies a transaction monitor or recovery feature without original source.
records.independent_oracle: Acquire product/version and original recovery test before moving any authority.

notes: Links to product documentation describe possible product behavior only: not installed configuration, current support or achieved SLO.
